name: Your Company
tagline: A residential quarter by the park: five buildings, a car-free courtyard and a school next door

listing.description: A website for a residential complex, developer or new-build agency. A skyline with windows lighting up, floor-plan drawings with a switcher, construction progress bars and prices by apartment type.

seo.title: Your Company — new homes by the park in Chilanzar
seo.description: Apartments from 42 to 118 m² in a quarter of five buildings: a car-free courtyard, underground parking, a school and kindergarten nearby. Phase one completes in Q4 2027, with instalments over up to 24 months.
seo.answer: Your Company is a quarter of five buildings, 9 to 16 storeys high, by the park in Tashkent’s Chilanzar district. One-bedroom apartments from 42.5 m² start at 620 million UZS, two-bedroom from 64 m² at 890 million UZS and three-bedroom from 86 m² at 1,180 million UZS. Phase one completes in Q4 2027, and instalments over up to 24 months are available with a 30% down payment.

sections.title: Where the courtyard belongs to children
sections.subtitle: Five buildings around a car-free courtyard, beside the park and ten minutes from the metro. Apartments with finished layouts and turnkey interiors.

sections.label: The project
sections.title: A neighbourhood, not just a building
sections.text: Your Company is being built on a 3.2-hectare site next to the park. Cars go into a 640-space underground car park, leaving the courtyard to people: playgrounds for different ages, a sports area and a quiet shaded garden. The ground floors hold a café, a pharmacy and a grocery, with a school and kindergarten across the road.

items.title: 1-bedroom
items.text: A kitchen-living room and a bedroom facing the courtyard, with a 4 m² loggia.

items.title: 2-bedroom
items.text: Two separate bedrooms, a 22 m² kitchen-living room and a walk-in wardrobe.

items.title: 3-bedroom
items.text: A master bedroom with en-suite, two children’s rooms and a corner living room.

items.title: 4-bedroom
items.text: Two bathrooms, a study and a terrace on the upper floors.

items.title: Excavation and foundations — 100%
items.text: Completed in March and signed off by the technical supervisor.

items.title: Concrete frame — 72%
items.text: Buildings 1 and 2 are at floor 14, building 3 at floor 9.

items.title: Facades and windows — 30%
items.text: Cladding has started on building 1, and windows are going in from the ground floor up.

items.title: Utilities — 25%
items.text: External water and sewer mains are laid.

items.title: Courtyard landscaping — 0%
items.text: Starts once the cranes come down, planned for spring 2027.

sections.label: Renderings
sections.title: What the quarter will look like

items.a: Phase one (buildings 1–3) completes in Q4 2027 and phase two (buildings 4–5) in Q2 2028. We update construction progress on the site every month.
A down payment from 30%, then equal interest-free payments over up to 24 months, finishing no later than completion.

items.q: Can I buy with a mortgage?
items.a: Yes, the project is accredited with several banks. A manager will help you gather documents and compare offers.

items.q: What’s included in the turnkey finish?
items.a: Walls, floors, doors, sanitaryware and lighting in one of three styles: you can move in as soon as you get the keys.
Yes, we run site tours with an engineer on Saturdays at 11:00; book on Telegram.

sections.label: Sales office
sections.title: We’ll find the right home for your family
sections.text: Visit the sales office by the site or message us on Telegram, and we’ll send available layouts and an instalment calculation.
